source.check: returned unopposed: 'Members returned unopposed are' (Newry Reporter, 5 June 1952, p. 5, continued art. 132); sole nomination (Newry Reporter, 22 May 1952, p. 1); at the new council's triennial meeting (Newry Reporter, 19 June 1952, p. 8)

note: Triennial election of the 17 electoral divisions of Kilkeel rural district, one member each, polled on 5 June 1952. Four divisions were contested (Bryansford, Dunnaman, Glasdrummond, Maghera); the other thirteen members were returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
